name: Kayal Foods
tagline: A taste of God's Own Country
positioning: Kerala's village table, served proudly in Sydney.

whatsapp.joinMessage: Hi Kayal! I'd like to join the offers group.
whatsapp.bookingMessage: Hi Kayal! I'd like to book a table.
whatsapp.consentCopy: We will be adding your number to the WhatsApp Group. You will be receiving our periodic offers via this.

policies.bookingOnly: Dine-in is by booking only — call or WhatsApp us and we'll keep your table ready.
policies.lastOrders: Kitchen takes last orders 45 minutes before closing, so every dish leaves the pot at its best.
policies.sitting: Tables are yours for a relaxed 90 minutes — it keeps the wait fair for the next family at the door.

findingUs.headline: No big sign. Just a white house.
findingUs.blurb: We're the white house on Nuwarra Road — look for the warm lights and the smell of curry leaves. On-site parking out front (around 5 spots), with street parking nearby.
findingUs.parkingNote: On-site parking for about 5 cars, plus street parking on Nuwarra Road.
